verdict.rationale: Okta has dedicated first-party documentation and a dev playground specifically for securing AI agent access: Cross App Access (XAA) via OIDC for agent-to-app connections, an XAA developer playground demonstrating token exchange without exposing credentials, and an official MCP server exposing scoped Admin Management API access for agents. This directly addresses agent identity, cross-app access, and scoped credentials as first-class patterns. Missing for 10: explicit 'token vaulting' terminology/documentation and independent hands-on validation of these agent-specific flows beyond Okta's own blog posts.
